episodes.title: Episode One
episodes.summary: An event goes awry in the New York park, which Owen manages and lives in with his family. Paige chases a hard news story.

episodes.title: Skater's Circle
episodes.summary: Bitsy pitches her plan to buy the park. Owen deals with a mini-mugging in Skater's Circle.

episodes.title: Hat Luncheon
episodes.summary: Owen speaks at a tense Hat Luncheon charity event. Cole helps Molly meet up with Brendan.

episodes.title: Garbage Ballet
episodes.summary: Paige hunts a rat, Owen battles trash in the park, and Molly obsesses over her disastrous first kiss.

episodes.title: Dog Spray Afternoon
episodes.summary: Owen grapples with a graffiti artist tagging the park, while Helen plots against Bitsy's dog, Shampagne.

episodes.title: Rival Busker
episodes.summary: Birdie's job is threatened by a rival busker, Bitsy hosts a wedding, and Paige spends the night at The Brandenham.

episodes.title: Squirrel, Interrupted
episodes.summary: Cole and Owen do a Squavenger Hunt in Central Park. Paige discovers Molly is a great chess player.

episodes.title: Hot Oven
episodes.summary: Molly introduces Brendan to the family. Helen stumbles upon a new way to get Shampagne out of her life.

episodes.title: Live it Up Tonight
episodes.summary: Molly and Cole go on a special park tour as Owen and Paige try to have a date night.

episodes.title: A Fish Called Snakehead
episodes.summary: Owen and his family search for a snakehead fish that might be in the Harlem Meer. Bitsy works with a likability consultant.

episodes.title: Central Dark
episodes.summary: A tristate blackout leaves Bitsy and Helen trapped in New Jersey—and forces the Tillerman family to see each other in a new light.

episodes.title: Mother's Daze
episodes.summary: Owen and the kids go all out for Paige on Mother's Day. Bitsy has to handle things on her own when Helen takes a day off.

episodes.title: Fista Puffs Mets Out Justice
episodes.summary: As a test to see if she's worthy of joining an elite girl group, Fista Puffs battles a monster in the Metropolitan Museum of Art.

episodes.title: Of Course You Realize This Means Ward
episodes.summary: Owen oversees a kids' field trip in the park, while Molly and Cole help Brendan with his indoor kite competition. Bitsy and her brother write memoirs.

episodes.title: Down to the Underwire
episodes.summary: When Molly needs a new bra, Owen takes her shopping. Helen finds a key that could finally reveal whether she's in Bitsy's will.

episodes.title: The Shadow
episodes.summary: The Brandenham is robbed by a jewel thief, reminding Bitsy of a criminal who terrorized the hotel over 50 years ago.

episodes.title: A Decent Proposal
episodes.summary: Owen does damage control after accidentally ruining a marriage proposal. Molly attends Bitsy's birthday party with Brendan.

episodes.title: Sir Bricks-A-Lot
episodes.summary: When Owen considers a new job in Connecticut, the family uses Cole's toys to imagine what their lives would be like if they moved out of the park.

episodes.title: A Boat-iful Mind
episodes.summary: Cole finds an escape from his homework in model sail-boating. Molly becomes a published artist in the school newspaper but isn't proud of her work.

episodes.title: Bee Is for Brandenham
episodes.summary: Owen is called to the Brandenham to help Bitsy deal with a swarm of bees, while Paige and the kids attempt to care for her boss' cat.

episodes.title: The PAIGE-riarchy!
episodes.summary: Paige tries to convince Molly that her period is a blessing. Bitsy is desperate to get back on a prestigious list of rich women over 50.

episodes.title: Castle Sweet Castle
episodes.summary: Owen and Paige set out to make the castle everything they dreamed it would be—if they can get the approval.

episodes.title: Celeste We Forget
episodes.summary: Owen's mom derails a trip to the botanical garden when she makes a surprise visit. Paige chases a lead while writing a fluff piece on gifting suites.

episodes.title: The Ballad of Johnnie Lee
episodes.summary: After an embarrassing moment at school, Cole wants to change his name and identity. Owen, Paige, and Molly tell stories to help him cope.

episodes.title: Where There's Smoke
episodes.summary: In search of evidence for a story, Paige brings the family to a wake. Bitsy and Helen try to convince a big investor to join them in buying Central Park.

episodes.title: A Lyin' in Winter
episodes.summary: Season finale. Bitsy and Helen get stranded during a blizzard. The family finds out that the deal to sell Central Park is happening today.

episodes.title: A Star Is Owen
episodes.summary: The Tillerman family welcomes spring as an episode of a hit crime show films in the park.

episodes.title: Paige's Next Chapter
episodes.summary: As Paige prepares for a big meeting with a book publisher, she welcomes her sister Abby to New York City.

episodes.title: Ice Ice Not Baby
episodes.summary: Molly and Brendan get into their first big fight, while Abby gets her first big commercial audition for a local deli.

episodes.title: A Triptych Down Memory Lane
episodes.summary: Elwood forgets the password he created for the Tillermans' hard drive, so the family must help him remember it or their memories will be erased.

episodes.title: Golden Owen: Manager Damager
episodes.summary: In order to get his "I Heart the Park" campaign proposal approved, Owen has to repair old friendships at the Park Managers' Conference.

episodes.title: A Matter of Life and Boeuf
episodes.summary: When the Tillermans visit Abby at her new job as waitress, a precious item goes missing—and everyone in the restaurant is a suspect.

episodes.title: Slumber-Dog-Molly-An-Aire
episodes.summary: Molly hosts her first teenage slumber party, which creates a rift between her and Paige.

episodes.title: Lunar Palaver
episodes.summary: On the day of the Lunar Palaver — a big Squirrel Quarrels event — Cole has a run-in with a racist lady in the park.

episodes.title: A Killer Deadline
episodes.summary: Paige checks into a hotel to focus on two writing deadlines. Owen volunteers for a school kickball tournament that Molly is trying to avoid.

episodes.title: Money Candy
episodes.summary: Owen and Paige set out to buy tickets to a K-pop boy band's concert for the kids. Bitsy looks into cloning her dog.

episodes.title: The Puffs Go Poof
episodes.summary: Fista Puffs considers straightening her hair.

episodes.title: A Hot Dog to Remember
episodes.summary: When a beloved hot dog vendor has to take a rare morning off, Owen and Cole volunteer to help set up his cart so he can break a park record.

episodes.title: The Brandenpire Strikes Back
episodes.summary: Owen's "I Heart the Park" campaign is in full swing with all hands on deck. Bitsy schemes to cement her political influence.
